responsibility: This header declares the object-export support routines used by the Rust frontend and backend integration. It exposes helpers for struct-field alignment and for reading or writing serialized Rust export metadata from or to object files, providing the small shared interface consumed by the GCC backend and crate import/export code paths.
same_name_distinction: Declares the small object-export interface—field-alignment querying plus read/write entry points for serialized Rust export metadata—that other Rust frontend/backend code calls. Unlike `rust-object-export.cc`, it contains no object-section logic or `simple-object` based implementation.
